ModMetaData.name: FemaleBodyVariants
ModMetaData.author: tiagocc0
ModMetaData.description:
This mod provides a way to load, on the fly, a different body texture for thin, fat and hulk females. It will use these names:
Naked_Thin_Female_south.png Naked_Thin_Female_east.png Naked_Thin_Female_north.png
Naked_Fat_Female_east.png Naked_Fat_Female_north.png Naked_Fat_Female_south.png
Naked_Hulk_Female_east.png Naked_Hulk_Female_north.png Naked_Hulk_Female_south.png
It only changes the texture if one of these files exists, so this mod by itself won't change anything visually, but in conjunction with a texture mod that contains the files above you will be able to see the female variation of those three body types. It also works for fur covered bodies, like FurCovered_Thin_Female_south.png, and body tattoos follow the female body shape.
Races with their own body textures are left alone, it only changes pawns using the normal vanilla body.
Anyone is free to use this mod as a pre requisite for your own mod.
My female body textures that use this mod, based on Beautiful Bodies from ireth92: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3215805750
Non Steam version: https://github.com/purpleorangegames/FemaleBodyVariants
AI was used to help code/fix issues
